scope: Phase1 feasibility worker only: authenticate/reproduce preserved mip failure and prove the one hypothetical 1024-square capacity layout. No new UV atlas, padding, spatial material sample, bake, GLB export or rendering is approved by this receipt.

independent_synthetic_tests.scope: New pure support helper tested against real old mip sampler, including exact-zero taps, half LOD, outer clamp, full triangle ranges, negative bounds and overlapping owners. No private material-filter execution.

independent_analytic_capacity.method: For each interval, q=clamp(p/2**L-0.5,0,1024/2**L-1), support=[floor(q_low)*2**L,(ceil(q_high)+1)*2**L). Full triangle extrema enclose every barycentric point; adjacent-level support unions cover every fractional LOD. Rectangles aligned to32 prevent dyadic boxes crossing owners.

quality_evidence_limitations: This GO establishes one deterministic capacity/support proposal only; it is not a new-padding quality PASS.
Old B-minus-C per-island conditional errors passed all44 island/LOD numerical cases, but that truncated footprint does not prove quality after changed padding or mip phase.
The hypothetical layout has not yet produced revised UVs, textures or a portable asset; a separately reviewed phase2 must retain every original accuracy and preservation gate.
The declared F64 linear-box mip filter is not universal game-engine compatibility.
